chunks: Read in the name of your Lord who created
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Read in the name of your Lord who created'?
ai.summary: This verse, revealed as the first in chronological order, marks the inception of Prophethood and the divine commission to seek knowledge, establishing the necessity of invoking God's name as the source of all authority. In Shia tradition, it is often linked to the concept of 'Ilm' (knowledge) being a divine gift, with the Prophet's family serving as the ultimate recipients and interpreters of this revealed wisdom. The command underscores the spiritual prerequisite for engaging with the Quran, framing recitation not merely as a ritual but as an act of connecting with the Creator.
